name: Canva
summary: Online design and publishing tool: make social posts, presentations, videos, print and websites from templates.
description: Web design platform launched in 2013, used by 220M+ monthly users across 190 countries and 100+ languages. Its surfaces cover social posts, presentations, whiteboards, docs and sheets, photo and video editing, print products, website building and PDF editing, with features like background remover, mockups, image enhancer and AI image generation; Plans and Canva for business sections add Pro and business tiers, and the homepage serves a browser-support wall to older clients.
